calibration_sources: HybridFlow / verl (3D-HybridEngine Zero-Redundancy Weight Resharding & CuMemAllocator Sleep/Wake)
THUDM Slime & AReaL (Asynchronous RL, Partial Rollout KV Continuation & Token-Level Importance Sampling TIS)
DeepSeek-R1 / Kimi-k1.5 Long-CoT RLVR Straggler Tail Distribution & Partial Rollout Benchmarks

workload.cluster_and_model: 128x H100 80GB SXM5 Cluster training 70B Reasoning Model via GRPO / RLVR (Group G=16, max Long-CoT response 32K tokens)
workload.long_tail_bottleneck: 90% of rollouts finish in <4K tokens (18s), while 5% of hard math/code rollouts hit 32K tokens (160s), creating a massive synchronous tail bubble
workload.key_mechanisms: verl 3D-HybridEngine bucketed AllGather resharding + CuMemAllocator sleep/wake vs. Slime/AReaL Partial Rollout + Token-Level Importance Sampling (TIS)

tiers.name: Tier 1: 静态切卡分离式 Ping-Pong 阻塞架构 (64卡采样与64卡训练交替干等 + 42s 权重拷贝 -> 空泡率 54.0%)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Static Disaggregated Split with Ping-Pong Blocking (54.0% Bubble · 42.0s Sync · 19.5% MFU)
tiers.execution_and_memory_topology: 64 GPUs dedicated to vLLM Rollout + 64 GPUs dedicated to FSDP Trainer; alternates synchronously
tiers.straggler_and_reshard_handling: Trainer idles 100% during 160s rollout; Rollout idles during training; 42.0s TCP/gRPC weight copy
tiers.recommended_for: Legacy RLHF prototypes only; wastes over half of cluster GPU hours in alternating idle waits.

tiers.name: Tier 2: 朴素同卡混部 + 主机内存权重倒腾 (34s 卸载重载破坏 CUDA Graph + 同步死等 32K 最慢长尾 -> 空泡率 41.5%)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: Naive Synchronous Colocated + Host Weight Reload (41.5% Bubble · 34.0s Reload · 27.2% MFU)
tiers.execution_and_memory_topology: All 128 GPUs run Rollout then Trainer, offloading weights to CPU DRAM between phases
tiers.straggler_and_reshard_handling: 34.0s PCIe weight reload + CUDA Graph re-capture; 95% of GPUs sit idle waiting for the last 32K CoT sample
tiers.recommended_for: Small single-node RL experiments without CUDA VMM or bucketed resharding.

tiers.name: Tier 3: verl 3D-HybridEngine 同卡混部 + CuMemAllocator 零拷贝休眠 (2.1s 极速重分片 · 适合中短序列同步 GRPO)
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: verl 3D-HybridEngine Colocated + VMM Sleep/Wake (2.1s Reshard · 22.8% CoT Bubble · 41.8% MFU)
tiers.execution_and_memory_topology: All 128 GPUs colocated; 3D-HybridEngine reshards FSDP/Megatron <-> vLLM/SGLang in-place via NVLink buckets
tiers.straggler_and_reshard_handling: 2.1s zero-redundancy resharding + VMM sleep preserves CUDA Graphs, but synchronous step barrier still waits on 32K tail
tiers.recommended_for: Standard synchronous GRPO/PPO where response lengths are bounded (<8K tokens) and strict on-policy is desired.

tiers.name: Tier 4: Slime / AReaL 异步流式解耦 + Partial Rollout 截断续生 + TIS 逐词重要性采样 (空泡仅 4.8% · 吞吐 2.85x)
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: Slime / AReaL Async Streaming + Partial Rollout + Token-Level TIS (4.8% Bubble · 55.6% MFU · 2.85x)
tiers.execution_and_memory_topology: Async streaming Rollout <-> Trainer overlap + in-place FP8/NVFP4 RDMA weight broadcast (1.1s)
tiers.straggler_and_reshard_handling: Pauses unfinished 32K rollouts at 85% batch watermark, resumes KV cache next step, and corrects staleness via TIS
tiers.recommended_for: Long-CoT (16K-64K) RLVR reasoning & multi-turn agentic RL where tail latency skews 10x+.
